python_igraph._meta: python-igraph 0.11.9 — VertexClustering(g, membership=...).membership is the closest user-facing wrapper that performs the same densification; timed in pure Python over 2000-5000 calls per cell

notes: Single-pass O(n) densifier with two branches: fast path (max_id < n) uses a flat Vec<u32> as the old-id -> new-id lookup; sparse fallback uses a BTreeMap when ids overflow that window.
Allocates: one Vec<u32> of size n (output), one Vec<u32> of size n in the fast path (lookup table), a Vec<u32> of size k (new_to_old). Sparse fallback adds a BTreeMap<u32, u32> with k entries.

Speedup over python-igraph stays well above 100x in the fast path because VertexClustering's __init__ + .membership access copies the membership through Python several times. The sparse-path advantage narrows toward 10x as the BTreeMap probes start to dominate.
